subtitle: An eastern farming village at the edge of the Wasting
canonNote: Canon: Oakhaven is an eastern agricultural hub erased by an accelerated, localized Wasting event that hid the Council's abduction of resonance candidates (interactive map; Oakhaven village map). This zone shows it on the eve of that erasure. Layout follows the canon village map. The Concord collectors, Mira and exact building placement are GAME-ONLY / PROVISIONAL. The wolf and boar camps and the south road to the Ashland Rim are GAME-ONLY. Crowsfoot Hollow (the cave past the end of the North road, in the west heel of Crowsfoot Ridge, running deep under the northern hills), its Sandthrone deserters, Quartermaster Hesk and Caddock, the Bandit King are GAME-ONLY; the Sandthrone company is CANON. The second growth (2026-10-01, 380 to 560 m, playtest note 1): the hollow and Crowsfoot Ridge moved out to the north hills, and Carder's field barn, Thornshaw, the Carter's Rest, Lark Hill, Sallow Bottom and the Bound wood are GAME-ONLY places. The outer farmland (2026-09-30 growth): Crowsfoot Ridge over the hollow, the Overlook, the Mastwood and Moss's lodge, the Old Fold and Old Whitefoot, the Bound Stone, the Cider Barn, Withy pool, the Old Barrow, Hollin farm, the Hallow's Creek milestone and the Watchtower are GAME-ONLY places; the farm animals (the horses at the Golden Cask and Carder's field barn, the miller's donkey, the Brook and Harrow cows, 2026-10-03) are GAME-ONLY; the hill overlooking the valley, Oakhaven's cider and its deep springs (book1 ch.4), the First Kin (sworn by in book1 ch.4) and Hallow's Creek, the first settlement the Wasting took (world_bible.md), are CANON. Bears in the hill hazels under Crowsfoot Ridge, and Old Hazelmaw (2026-10-04): GAME-ONLY.
worldMapNote: Pin follows the interactive chart (eastern farmlands); the exact spot is provisional.
objectives: Find Mira inside the Golden Cask
Arm yourself with a recovered blade [I]

exits.name: South road to the Ashland Rim (dangerous, 9-10)

wasting.note: Canon: the Wasting unmakes rather than destroys, leaving grey static.

landmarks.name: The Great Oak
landmarks.text: Ancient and in full leaf: the heart of the green.

landmarks.name: The Golden Cask
landmarks.text: Oakhaven's inn. Its cellar hears everything.

landmarks.name: Communal Well
landmarks.text: The water has started to taste of iron.

landmarks.name: The Wasting
landmarks.text: Not fire, not rot. The world simply stops.

landmarks.name: Oak creek mill
landmarks.text: The wheel still turns, though there's less and less to grind.

landmarks.name: Harrow farm
landmarks.text: The Harrows lost a daughter to the collectors.

landmarks.name: The Old Orchard
landmarks.text: Planted by someone's great-grandmother, when the east was still green.

landmarks.name: Old wayshrine
landmarks.text: Offerings here have turned grey and brittle.

landmarks.name: Harrow hen coop
landmarks.text: Goody Marl's hens. She counts them in every dusk.

landmarks.name: Vell's smithy
landmarks.text: Brannoc Vell mends ploughs and hinges. The Concord took his good iron.

landmarks.name: Market row
landmarks.text: Three stalls along the north road; fewer carts come every season.

landmarks.name: Thorne's bakehouse
landmarks.text: The oven has not gone cold in forty years.

landmarks.name: Tannery yard
landmarks.text: Downwind of the village, for good reason.

landmarks.name: Woodyard
landmarks.text: Stacked for a winter that may come early.

landmarks.name: The black-iron wagon
landmarks.text: A Concord cage on wheels. The villagers won't go near it.

landmarks.name: Brook pond
landmarks.text: Deep and cold. The Brook children dare each other to swim it.

landmarks.name: The tall grass
landmarks.text: Something moves in it when the wind drops. Sneak (Ctrl) if you must cross.

landmarks.name: Crowsfoot Hollow
landmarks.text: A cave in the north hills, in the west heel of the ridge where nobody looks. Lately, smoke by night.

landmarks.name: Crowsfoot Ridge
landmarks.text: The north hills, splayed like a crow's foot. The hollow is in the heel of it, and the hall under the crown.
landmarks.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY name. The hill above Oakhaven's valley, from whose crest the village is first seen, is CANON (book1 ch.4).

landmarks.name: The Mastwood
landmarks.text: Old oak and beech, and a floor of mast. The Harrows turned their pigs out here once; the boars have it now.

landmarks.name: Moss's lodge
landmarks.text: Garet Moss's hunting lodge: hides on the rail, and a lantern he leaves lit for anyone caught out after dark.

landmarks.name: The Old Fold
landmarks.text: A dry-stone fold older than anyone's grandmother. The flock comes in at dusk, and something has been taking one a week.

landmarks.name: The Bound Stone
landmarks.text: Oakhaven's west bound, an acorn cut on this side and nothing on the other. Past it the road is Khaven's, and the light goes dim and stays that way.

landmarks.name: The Cider Barn
landmarks.text: Oakhaven's cider is pressed here every autumn: the sweetest in the Reach, and the Cask will sell it to anyone who can carry it.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Oakhaven's cider, the finest and sweetest in the Reach, is CANON (book1 ch.4); the barn and the orchard are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: Withy pool
landmarks.text: Springs well up into a reedy pool under the downs: the deep water the whole valley drinks. The boars wallow at its edge.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Oakhaven's clean water from deep, untouched aquifers is CANON (book1 ch.4); the pool is GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Old Barrow
landmarks.text: A turfed mound on the rise. Folk say the First Kin lie in it, and swear by them. Someone has thrown the door-stone down.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the First Kin, sworn by in book1 ch.4, are CANON; the barrow and its tale are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: Hollin farm
landmarks.text: Empty since spring, when the Hollins' east field went grey in a night. They left the door open and the gate on the latch.

landmarks.name: Hallow's Creek milestone
landmarks.text: HALLOW'S CREEK, the stone says, and points down a road that runs on a few paces and stops. Hallow's Creek was the first to go.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Hallow's Creek, the first settlement the Wasting took, is CANON (world_bible.md); the milestone and the road to it are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Watchtower
landmarks.text: Built to watch the east road for raiders. Oakhaven takes turns up there now, watching the grey come on.

landmarks.name: Carder farm
landmarks.text: Wil Carder's new thatch, still yellow. The West field hens scratch across the lane.

landmarks.name: Tanner's leather shop
landmarks.text: Maud Tanner cuts and stitches here, upwind of the tannery yard. Bags hang over the counter.

landmarks.name: Lisbet's drying hut
landmarks.text: Yarrow, feverfew and comfrey hung head-down to dry. It smells of hay and bitter tea.

landmarks.name: Carder's field barn
landmarks.text: Wil Carder's barn on the north fields, the last roof on the North road. The door hangs off one hinge and the seed-corn is gone.

landmarks.name: Thornshaw
landmarks.text: Oak and thorn too thick to plough. The wolves lie up in it by day, and the north farms count their lambs twice.

landmarks.name: The Carter's Rest
landmarks.text: Half way to the bound: an oak, a shrine and room to turn a wain. Khaven's carters water their horses here and do not stay the night.

landmarks.name: Lark Hill
landmarks.text: A bare down with a ring of stones on its crown. Larks go up from it all summer, and from the top you can see the road to both ends.

landmarks.name: Sallow Bottom
landmarks.text: The ground never dries here. The Brook farm's pigs went wild in the sallows two winters back, and nobody has gone to fetch them.

landmarks.name: The Bound wood
landmarks.text: The last wood before the bound. Its wolves cross the West road at dusk, and the carters whip up when they pass it.

landmarks.name: Training yard
landmarks.text: A fenced sparring ground: straw for blades, butts for arrows, bandages for prayers.

landmarks.name: The Hollin skeps
landmarks.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (the Hollins and their bees); the Wasting greying the east is CANON (book1 ch.4, world_bible.md)
landmarks.text: Ada Hollin's bees, carried over the creek on a hurdle the night the east field went grey. The skeps are here. The bees are not.

landmarks.name: The grey picket
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Council's Seekers closing the road at Hallow's Creek as a 'quarantine' is CANON (lore_stories.md); the Concord's picket at Oakhaven's grey, and its wardens, are GAME-ONLY
landmarks.text: A Concord fire by the ruts into the grey. The wardens turn back anyone who goes to look, and write down who asked.

landmarks.name: The Silent Watcher
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Statues, giant faceless monoliths standing in the Wasting, are CANON (world_bible.md); that one stands at Oakhaven's grey, and its name, are GAME-ONLY
landmarks.text: A hooded figure of pale stone, taller than the Watchtower, standing to its knees in the grey with nothing in its hood. Nobody raised it. It was there when the grey came, and the grey has not taken it.

landmarks.name: Wick's cot
landmarks.text: Ferris Wick's cottage, burnt to its footings in the spring. He burned it himself, the village says, and everything he had carried over from the Hollins' side, and he sleeps in the Brook barn now and will not say why.

landmarks.name: The Farrows' stand
landmarks.text: Where the Farrows cut the Cask's winter wood: the pile, the cart and Pim's first axe-mark on the big stump. The carts stopped coming south when the stalkers took to the tall grass.

landmarks.name: The Old Delf
landmarks.text: The village cut its stone here: the well's kerb, the mill's footings, the Bound Stone itself. The face came down the winter the old miller died, and nobody has dug it out.

landmarks.name: The Harrow knoll
landmarks.text: A knob of the west downs over the Khaven road. Sel Harrow climbs it on the seventh day of every week and comes down slower than he went up.

landmarks.name: Hesper's hut
landmarks.text: Hesper Crane's hut on the downs: Lisbet's grandmother, who taught her the yarrow and the feverfew. She went up here when the collectors came and will not come down while they are in the village.

landmarks.name: The foragers' camp
landmarks.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY band (Caddock's, out of Crowsfoot Hollow); the Sandthrone company they deserted is CANON
landmarks.text: Caddock's foragers, down from the hollow to rob the north farms: the Carder barn's seed-corn went up this hill. They keep a fire and no watch worth the name.

landmarks.name: The webbed sallows
landmarks.text: The wet sallows east of the bottom, where the Brook pigs went wild. Something has webbed the lower boughs from trunk to trunk, and the pigs do not go in there any more.

landmarks.name: The wolf pit
landmarks.text: The north farms' wolf-pit, dug when Old Whitefoot's grandsire ran the Top field. Kerbed with stone, deep as a man, and the last thing it caught was not a wolf.

props.name: Harrow grain bin
props.interact: Take a sack of clean grain

props.name: Notice board
props.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED (the Bureau and the Seekers post their wanted bills; the village its bounties)

camps.name: Old Hazelmaw
camps.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (an old bear of the hill hazels)

camps.name: The grey picket
camps.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY picket; the Council's Seekers closing the road to Hallow's Creek and calling it a quarantine is CANON (lore_stories.md)

camps.name: Downs hart
camps.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (the red hart of the west downs; it lies up in the Carr wood by day)

camps.name: Foragers' camp
camps.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY band (Caddock's foragers, down from Crowsfoot Hollow to rob the north farms); the Sandthrone company they deserted is CANON

secrets.name: The Road's End
secrets.text: Someone has stacked three stones where the cart ruts run into the grey and stop, mid-rut, as if the road had been rolled up and put away. Past them nothing moves: not grass, not dust, not light.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY place. The Wasting unmaking the land into grey static is CANON (world_bible.md).

secrets.name: The Poacher's Cold Camp
secrets.prompt: Search the bundle at the cold camp
secrets.text: A cold fire ring under the copse eaves, a snare line, and a bundle done up in oilcloth against the rain. Whoever camped here left in a hurry and hasn't come back for it.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: A Salt-Mender's Drop
secrets.prompt: Reach in behind the shrine's plinth
secrets.text: A tin pushed in behind the plinth, a salt-stiff cord knotted round it: a Salt-Mender drop. Coins, a draught of yarrow and honey, and a scrap in a careful hand: Take what you need. Mend what you can.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Salt-Menders are a canon faction (world_bible.md); their drops, and this one, are GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: A Leaf from the Chapel Book
secrets.prompt: Reach into the hollow stump
secrets.text: Folded small and pushed deep into the hollow of the old stump by the chapel wall, where the damp couldn't reach it: a leaf cut out of the chapel book.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the chapel book and its oath. The Great Oak as the settlement's historical heart is CANON (book1 ch.4).

secrets.name: Moonbells
secrets.prompt: Pick the pale bells
secrets.text: Pale bells glowing faintly in the copse's shade. Hedge-wives say moonbells only grow where the ground is still sure of itself.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: A Key on the Drop
secrets.prompt: Take the key down from its nail
secrets.text: An iron key hangs on a nail driven into the rock, where a sentry on the Drop could reach it without looking.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: The Quartermaster's Strongbox
secrets.prompt: Unlock the strongbox
secrets.text: The band's pay chest, or what is left of it: a little company silver, the Quartermaster's own lantern, and the King's orders, copied fair.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: The Overlook
secrets.text: From the knob of the hill the whole valley lies open: the Great Oak's crown over the roofs, smoke from the Cask, the mill wheel on Oak creek, the fields stitched together like a quilt. Past the farthest of them the haze is the wrong colour.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the hill over Oakhaven's verdant valley is CANON (book1 ch.4); the lookout is GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: The Shepherd's Tin
secrets.prompt: Reach into the gap at the foot of the wall
secrets.text: Pushed into a gap at the foot of the fold, where the shepherds sit out of the wind: a dented tin, a heel of Harrow cheese in a cloth, a few coins, and the flock's tally scratched on the lid. The last five marks are struck through, one a week.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: A Grave-Robber's Bundle
secrets.prompt: Search the bundle by the barrow door
secrets.text: Whoever threw the door-stone down didn't stay to go in: an oilcloth bundle dropped among the stones before the door, a pick and a dark lantern, a few old coins green with age and a stoppered draught. Whatever is in the barrow, they thought better of it.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the robber and the bundle. The First Kin are CANON (book1 ch.4); that they lie here is GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: A Letter from Hallow's Creek
secrets.prompt: Draw the letter out of the crack in the wall
secrets.text: Folded small into a crack in the farmhouse wall, out of the rain: a letter, much read, to Ada Hollin at Oakhaven.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Hallow's Creek, the first settlement the Wasting took, is CANON (world_bible.md); the letter and the Hollins are GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: A Page from the Watch Book
secrets.prompt: Lift the flat stone at the tower's foot
secrets.text: Weighted under a flat stone at the foot of the watchtower, where the next watcher will look for it: a page torn from the watch book.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Wasting creeping on the eastern farms is CANON (book1 ch.4, world_bible.md); the watchtower and its book are GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: The Long View
secrets.text: From the stones on the crown the whole south-west lies open: the West road a pale thread to the bound, Withy pool like a dropped coin, the Great Oak a green smudge over the roofs. Westward the sky is the colour of a bruise, and stays that colour.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the hill and the view. Khaven Village is CANON (khaven_village_map.png); that it lies up the West road from Oakhaven, under a dusk that holds all day, is the game's.

secrets.name: The Carter's Stash
secrets.prompt: Reach in behind the shrine
secrets.text: A tin pushed in behind the wayside shrine, where a carter could reach it from the box without getting down: a few coins against a broken axle, a heel of cheese gone hard, and a lucky acorn on a thong.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: A Sack with the Carder Mark
secrets.prompt: Search the sack under the stone
secrets.text: Dropped where the track starts to climb and kicked under a stone to be fetched later: a seed-corn sack with the Carder mark burnt into it, a purse somebody skimmed from the king's share, and a stoppered draught. Whoever hid it has not been back.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: The Bee-wife's Tin
secrets.prompt: Reach in under the skep bench
secrets.text: Pushed in under the bench where the bee-wife sat to watch the flight holes: a tin with her honey-money in it, a twist of comb gone hard, and a honey cake wrapped in a dock leaf. Three skeps, and not a bee in any of them: they went in the night, all together, and west.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Hollins and their bees. The Wasting unmaking the east is CANON (world_bible.md).

secrets.name: Under the Watcher
secrets.text: Close under the hood there is only shadow, and the shadow does not move with the sun. At noon it lies west, toward the village, the wrong way, and it is the only shadow on this ground that lies anywhere at all.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Statues in the Wasting are CANON (world_bible.md); shadows lying the wrong way at noon before Hallow's Creek went is CANON (lore_stories.md); the lookout is GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: A Cowman's Tin
secrets.prompt: Lift the fallen door-stone
secrets.text: Under the door-stone, which the fire did not want: Ferris Wick's tin, with the Brook farm's cow-money in it and a draught against the ague, and scratched inside the lid, over and over, one word: CLEAN.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: Wick and his cot. The grey spreading from the Hollins' east field is the game's showing of the Wasting, which is CANON (book1 ch.4, world_bible.md).

secrets.name: The Cutter's Tin
secrets.prompt: Feel under the fallen trunk
secrets.text: Pushed under the trunk where the cutters sit for their bread: Osk Farrow's tin, with a Harrow pasty in a cloth, a whetstone, and the pay he owes the Cask for the last load, counted out and never carried in.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: The Quarryman's Tin
secrets.prompt: Search the cleft in the fallen rock
secrets.text: Wedged in the cleft where the face came down: the quarryman's tin, with his wedges' money in it, a lump of chalk, and a mason's mark cut in the lid, the same mark that is cut on the underside of the well's kerb, if you ever look.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: Wren's Cairn
secrets.text: A pile of stones on the crown of the knoll, one on another, thirty and more. Sel Harrow climbs up on the seventh day of every week and puts a stone on it: one for each week since the collectors' wagon went down the West road with Wren in it. From here you can see the road all the way to the Bound Stone. He watched it out of sight from here.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Harrows and their daughter, and the cairn. The Concord's taking of resonance candidates from Oakhaven is CANON (book1 ch.4).

secrets.name: Hesper's Simples
secrets.prompt: Look under the drying board
secrets.text: Under the board where Hesper dries her simples: a tin of what she will not sell, a dried moonbell in a twist of paper, and a note in Lisbet's hand: Gran, come down. The well is better. It isn't.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: The Foragers' Sack
secrets.prompt: Search the sack kicked under the bush
secrets.text: Kicked under a bush at the camp's edge to be carried up the hill later: a sack with the Carder mark, a loaf, the seed-corn's purse, and a tally of what the north farms have left, barn by barn, in a careful hand that is not a forager's.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: A Swineherd's Bundle
secrets.prompt: Pull the bundle out of the sallow roots
secrets.text: Col Pennock's bundle, wedged in the sallow roots where he dropped it: a pot of lard, a knife, and his boots, which he says the webs took. He went in after the pigs at the first frost and came out barefoot, and would not go back for them.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

secrets.name: A Forager's Pack
secrets.prompt: Search the pack at the bottom of the pit
secrets.text: At the bottom of the pit, where he left it to climb out: one of Caddock's foragers' packs, with the north farms' eggs in it, broken, a draught, and a letter from his mother that he never answered.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY (the pit and the forager); the Sandthrone company the foragers deserted is CANON
